items.rationale: The swerve impact is covered under 2.6.2 and 4.5.2, and the battery waiver disapplies the cutoff in 2.6.8. Under 7.1.10, the supplier report supports replacement at the gross cost of a new equivalent less achievable salvage; €1,300 is the estimated net amount, excluding the upgrade.
Under 7.1.9, the owner bears the separately billed price difference for the elective upgrade.

The screen crack is covered impact damage under 2.6.2–2.6.4; €240 gross estimates an ordinary like-for-like screen repair under 7.1.10. Both devices form one insured event, and no deductible amount is stated.

Section 5.2.3 covers necessary examination of both units even when the laptop repair is uneconomic. At about €72 per device, the combined €144 is below the €250 gross event cap and assumes no invoice credit.
Sections 4.2.6 and 7.1.5 cover a carry bag only if it was itself damaged by the event; the bag was undamaged.
Sections 3.5(f) and 7.1.8(e) expressly exclude extended warranties, even when purchased with a covered replacement.
Sections 3.5(d) and 4.3(c) exclude data recovery unless separately scheduled. The battery waiver does not provide that cover.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separate administration charges, including those billed by another provider. The underlying data recovery is also excluded.
